message: The other day, I was in the kitchen making my famous (or so I like to think!) spaghetti sauce when I heard that familiar chirp of our smoke alarm. Instead of panicking, I remembered my small win: I had just checked the batteries last week! 😅 I grabbed a towel, waved it around, and was back to cooking in no time. It made me realize that those little moments of preparation can really pay off. Have you checked your smoke alarms lately?
